original.statement: A storage version migration of EC2NodeClass from v1beta1 to v1 is required; existing objects remain in v1beta1 storage until explicitly migrated, and v1beta1 will be removed in a later release.

corrected.statement: The storage version of the ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws CRD changes from v1beta1 to v1. Existing EC2NodeClass objects must be rewritten through a storage version migration, and status.storedVersions updated, before a later release removes v1beta1.

decision.reason: The computed CRD diff between [ev-8998581760b8] (v0.37.8) and [ev-451bd6a12e72] (v1.0.0) says existing EC2NodeClass objects stay stored as v1beta1. It says to run a storage version migration and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1. That supports a migration-required change on a migration subject. The proposed name uses "upgrade", which is not in the evidence, and adds a version suffix it does not need. The shortest unambiguous kebab-case name built from the evidence's own words is "ec2nodeclasses-storage-version-migration". Confidence is low because the evidence excerpts themselves are empty and the decision rests on the change text derived from the diff.
